name: Manage Purchase Item
description: Add, update, remove, or query a single item on an existing purchase order. Plain fields only — no FEEL. unitPrice/name default from the catalog product; the order total is recomputed automatically.

properties.label: Operation
properties.description: Action to perform on a purchase item.

properties.label: Order ID
properties.description: Required for CREATE — the order to add the item to. For QUERY, lists all items on this order.

properties.label: Purchase Item ID
properties.description: Required. ID of the item to update.

properties.label: Purchase Item ID
properties.description: Required. ID of the item to remove.

properties.label: Purchase Item ID
properties.description: Optional. Returns a single item when provided; otherwise list by Order ID.

properties.label: Product ID
properties.description: Required for CREATE. The catalog product being purchased (its current RRP and name are used when price/name are left blank).

properties.label: Quantity
properties.description: Number of units. Defaults to 1 when blank.

properties.label: Unit Price
properties.description: Optional. Price per unit at order time. Defaults to the product's RRP when blank.

properties.label: Item Result Variable
properties.description: Process variable that receives the full response (item data, status, message).

properties.label: Operation Status Variable
properties.description: Shortcut variable: SUCCESS, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, or ERROR.
